chunks: It was also narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-Khathʿamī, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the woman in nifās, and he said: “According to how she used to be with what had passed of her previous children, and what she had experienced.” I said: “But if she had not given birth previously?” He said: “Between forty and fifty.”

key_terms.النُّفَسَاءِ: a woman in the state of postnatal bleeding after childbirth
key_terms.بَيْنَ الْأَرْبَعِينَ إِلَى الْخَمْسِينَ: a stated range for determining the period in the absence of prior experience
key_terms.فَلَمْ تَلِدْ: if she had not previously given birth
key_terms.مَا جَرَّبَتْ: what she had previously experienced and observed in her own condition

ai.seo_question: How is the duration of nifās determined for a woman after childbirth in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the duration of nifās after childbirth. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that it is determined based on a woman's previous experience with childbirth, and if she has no prior experience, a range between forty and fifty days is mentioned.
